name: Generator — Faction surpluses or needs
description:
When to use: A resource the faction has in abundance — or desperately lacks. Decide which fits.

How to read it: Treat the result as inspiration. Adapt it to your setting, combine with other rolls, or re-roll if nothing sparks.
